scripts.dev: npm run build -w @receptly/shared && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @receptly/server" "npm run dev -w @receptly/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @receptly/shared && npm run build -w @receptly/server && npm run build -w @receptly/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @receptly/shared && node --import ./tests/setup-env.mjs --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts
